The '''Th-15B War Medic''' was a type of [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]] heavily used in both the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]] by [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] soldiers, mercenaries, and bounty hunters alike. A lighter version of the armor was used by the young Mandalorian warrior, [[Torian Cadera]], during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] before he had switch to a new [[Wasteland Raider armor|Mandalorian armor]] set.
